| # VSS_2 (sensor supply 2) {#vss_2-sensor-supply-2-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                   |                                                                                                                                                    |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The cyclic check of the sensor supply voltage 2.

 

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Monitoring of overvoltage and undervoltage for error.

- The state of the VSS_2 can be queried using bds_sys_getVSS().

- In case of short circuit to ground the sensor supply will be switched-off. In case of short circuit to battery the sensor supply will not be switched-off.

- The overvoltage and undervoltage will be detected by the HW itself.

- If the undervoltage error is recovered then the switch-on of the sensor supply will be done by the HW itself.

  No need of separate call of bds_sys_setVSS().

- Over Voltage Error Limit = 5.250V

- Under Voltage Error Limit = 4.750V

- Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.

 

Error Reaction:

 

- Over Voltage Error  (VSS_2  \>= Over Voltage Error Limit)

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ --------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_OV_VSS2
  Error Code                     0x080300
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   no
  ECU Reset                      no
  bds_sys_setVSS(\...,OFF)       no
  Reaction time                  10ms

 

 

- Under Voltage Error ( VSS2 \<= Under Voltage Error Limit )

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ --------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_mo_UV_VSS2
  Error Code                     0x080400
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   no
  ECU Reset                      no
  bds_sys_setVSS(\...,OFF)       yes
  Reaction time                  10ms
